description: This file contains the implementation of the Application class within the Opencart Admin Controller Startup namespace. It initializes core components such as URL, customer, currency, tax, weight, length, and cart, setting them in the registry for use elsewhere in the application.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Defines the Application class responsible for initializing essential components during startup, such as URL, customer, currency, tax, weight, length, and cart, and setting them in the registry.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up various core components and services in the registry, including URL, customer, currency, tax, weight, length, and cart. It also loads a validation helper.
